name: Facet
text: Choose a fixed-height timeline strip at the top, always visible. It guarantees constant visibility of context without scrolling, keeping the interface lively and decisions clear. The trade-off is less vertical space for content below, but visibility and speed of understanding outweigh this for screencasts.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A fixed-height strip at the top buries the playback mark under fresh noise—users miss the moment decisions were made. Better: a collapsible strip that expands only when scrubbed, trading constant visibility for deliberate focus. Settle it with a 10-user test: measure how often they locate the playback mark with each design.
